concerns.text: FR-001 requires ingestion of the original LatentSkill LoRA adapters (ALFWorld and Search‑QA). The task downloads a *proxy* dataset (`mrm8488/peft‑examples`) instead, which weakens the functional requirement without an explicit staging justification.

SC-001 mandates that the success‑rate degradation of retrieval/interpolation methods be ≤ 10 % relative to the baseline. T018 only records raw success rates; there is no verification step that checks the ≤ 10 % degradation constraint.

SC-003 requires wall‑clock latency measurement for skill‑selection on a 2‑core CPU runner. T009’s verification checks dimensionality and warnings but does not record or assert any latency metric, leaving the latency criterion untested.
SC-004 calls for a sensitivity analysis over varying top‑k values. No task performs a sweep of k (e.g., 3, 5, 10) or validates robustness, so the sensitivity requirement is omitted.
Constitution Principle VII (edge‑deployment latency benchmarking) is violated because no task captures or validates the required CPU latency measurements for any skill‑selection strategy.
